name: A flood, an attack and a layer down

tactics.alert_message: Police activity in {zone}. Please avoid the area.

desks.prewarning: Water is rising near {zone} and may reach the flood line in about {when}. Keep clear of low-lying roads and be ready to move.

messages.fire: A fire has been reported near {zone}. Avoid the area and follow the instructions of the emergency services.
messages.accident: A serious accident has been reported near {zone}. Avoid the area; emergency services are on their way.
messages.flood: Flooding has been reported near {zone}. Stay away from the water and move to higher ground if you are close.
messages.jam: Heavy traffic near {zone}. Consider another route.
messages.overload: Power demand is very high near {zone}. Please use less if you can.
messages.smog: Air quality is poor near {zone}. Limit time outdoors.

capabilities.dispatch_unit: Dispatch a police, ambulance or fire unit. `call` is the actuator envelope.
capabilities.broadcast_alert: Send a public alert to one zone by SMS, siren or app. `call` is the actuator envelope.
capabilities.recall_unit: Stand a dispatched unit down and return it to its station. `call` is the actuator envelope.
capabilities.set_signal_phase: Hold one traffic signal in a phase (green, red, yellow, flashing) for up to an hour. `call` is the actuator envelope.
capabilities.set_valve_state: Open or close one water valve, optionally to a flow target. `call` is the actuator envelope.
capabilities.set_grid_connection: Connect or disconnect the power grid for one zone. `call` is the actuator envelope.
